evidence: Has the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and updates RPC argument parsing in src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp and src/rpc/rawtransaction_util.cpp.
rationale: The change adds explicit key-origin handling modes ('add', 'preserve', 'strip') to PSBT processing RPCs while maintaining backwards compatibility with boolean values. It addresses an interface gap where callers could not sanitize derivation metadata before sharing PSBTs (issue #30294).
